Ava: Anyone got music + short comedy recs for a 40-minute commute? Need stuff to keep me awake but not exhausted.
Jon: Music: The Go! Team or LCD Soundsystem for lively but not frantic. Podcasts also work 1 'Conan O'Brien Needs A Friend' for easy laughs. TV: 'I Think You Should Leave' sketches are short and absurd.
Priya: agree, sketches are commute-friendly (150 mins max). Music: Khruangbin instrumental licks are great background.
Ava: sketches sound perfect. Any specific playlist or album to queue?
Jon: Album rec: LCD Soundsystem - 'This Is Happening' or The Go! Team - 'Proof of Youth'. Both keep energy up.
EchoBot: Created playlist "Commute Boosters - Redwood" and sent to @Ava: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/commuteboosters (preview link).
Priya: quick poll: Sketches vs Podcast vs Upbeat Album for today's commute?
Jon: vote: Sketches :laughing:
Ava: vote: Upbeat Album :rocket:
Priya: vote: Podcast :coffee:
Ava: thanks y'all! starting with sketches and saving the album for tomorrow's ride.
